description_en: Queries the statistics of application whitelist policy
description_zh: 查询应用白名单策略统计信息
name: DescribeWhiteListStrategyStatistics

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The policy ID.
You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略编号。
调用[DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_ids

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned.

Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。最大值为1000，每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。

建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page
